analyst_view.overall: Second-tier Torreense (19th, 6 pts), the Portuguese Cup holders, host Celtic (32nd, 3 pts) in Leiria, because their own small ground does not meet UEFA rules. Torreense beat Ararat 3-2 with ten men last time in Europe, but scorer Jorge Aguirre is banned (counted, -8% on their goals), Baradji and Jatta are injured, and Dany Jean and Manu Pozo, three goals each, should lead the attack. Martin O'Neill confirmed that Benjamin Nygren (Achilles) has not travelled, which the numbers do not know; Mika Baur and Alistair Johnston are also out (both counted), while Jota has been added to the European squad and Trusty and Tierney are available. O'Neill warns his side are not good enough to take Torreense lightly, and Celtic play again in the league three days later. Dutch referee Allard Lindhout, who shows few cards (about 3.3 a game), is in charge and already counted.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals and already take about 19% off Celtic for Baur and 8% off Torreense for Aguirre's ban. O'Neill has now confirmed Nygren, one of Celtic's main attackers, did not travel; Jota's return to the squad softens that a little, so I keep my cut to about 2.6.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.9 corners, already up about 7% for Celtic's recent corner count and Torreense conceding many. Celtic should have most of the ball with or without Nygren, and Torreense's attack on the counter through Jean and Pozo does not change that, so I stay at 10.9.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.9 cards, already cut by about 25% for referee Allard Lindhout's low card record (3.3 a game in 61 games). Torreense finished their last European game with ten men and Mutombo is one yellow from a ban, but nothing points to a heated game, so I stay at 2.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.2 shots, already up for Celtic's recent shooting and Torreense allowing many shots lately. Without Nygren, Celtic lose one of their busiest shooters, which the numbers do not know, so I trim slightly, to about 26.7.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.0 shots on target. Without Baur (counted) and now confirmed without Nygren (not counted), Celtic lose two of their sharper shooters, so I go lower, to about 8.6.
